html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>AI 角色微软朗读</title>
</head>
<body></body>

<script>
  var isCookieJar = true;

  class FlutterJSBridge {
    constructor() {
      this.init();
    }

    init() {
      if (window.flutter_inappwebview) {
        this.isReady = true;
        this.CookieJar();
      } else {
        window.addEventListener('flutterInAppWebViewPlatformReady', () => {
          this.isReady = true;
          this.CookieJar();
        });
      }
    }

    async CookieJar() {
      try {
        await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('CookieJar', isCookieJar);
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    async log(message) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('log', String(message));
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    async showToast(message) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('showToast', String(message));
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  class Http {
    async Post(url, headers, body, contentType, followRedirects) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler(
          'http',
          'post',
          url,
          body,
          JSON.stringify(headers || {}),
          followRedirects !== false,
          contentType || 'application/json'
        );
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  class Cache {
    async get(key) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.get', key);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async set(key, value) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.set', key, value);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async remove(key) {
      try {
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.remove', key);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async getLoginInfo() {
      return await this.get('LoginInfo');
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
  const flutterBridge = new FlutterJSBridge();
  const http = new Http();
  const cache = new Cache();

  const DEFAULTS = {
    aiEndpoint: 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
    aiModel: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
    proxyEndpoint: 'http://5.45.99.149:8075/tts',
    narratorVoice: 'zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural'
  };

  const VOICE_POOLS = {
    female: {
      child: ['zh-CN-XiaoyouNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural'],
      teen: ['zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural'],
      young: ['zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaochenNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaomengNeural'],
      middle: ['zh-CN-XiaohanNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaomoNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaorouNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaoyanNeural'],
      senior: ['zh-CN-XiaoqiuNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaozhenNeural'],
      unknown: ['zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'zh-CN-XiaohanNeural']
    },
    male: {
      child: ['zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      teen: ['zh-CN-YunxiaNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural'],
      young: ['zh-CN-YunxiNeural', 'zh-CN-YunhaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      middle: ['zh-CN-YunjianNeural', 'zh-CN-YunfengNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjieNeural', 'zh-CN-YunzeNeural'],
      senior: ['zh-CN-YunyeNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyangNeural'],
      unknown: ['zh-CN-YunxiNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural']
    },
    unknown: {
      child: ['zh-CN-XiaoyouNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      teen: ['zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiaNeural'],
      young: ['zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural'],
      middle: ['zh-CN-XiaohanNeural', 'zh-CN-YunjianNeural'],
      senior: ['zh-CN-XiaoqiuNeural', 'zh-CN-YunyeNeural'],
      unknown: ['zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural']
    }
  };

  function parseObject(value, fallback) {
    if (!value) return fallback;
    if (typeof value === 'object') return value;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch (error) {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  async function readSettings() {
    const info = parseObject(await cache.getLoginInfo(), {});
    return {
      aiEndpoint: String(info['AI接口'] || DEFAULTS.aiEndpoint).trim(),
      aiKey: String(info['AI密钥'] || '').trim(),
      aiModel: String(info['AI模型'] || DEFAULTS.aiModel).trim(),
      proxyEndpoint: String(info['TTS中转'] || DEFAULTS.proxyEndpoint).trim(),
      narratorVoice: String(info['旁白音色'] || DEFAULTS.narratorVoice).trim(),
      aiEnabled: (await cache.get('ai_role_enabled')) !== 'false'
    };
  }

  function normalizeEndpoint(endpoint) {
    let url = String(endpoint || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!url) return DEFAULTS.aiEndpoint;
    if (/\/chat\/completions$/i.test(url)) return url;
    if (/\/v1$/i.test(url)) return url + '/chat/completions';
    return url + '/v1/chat/completions';
  }

  function hashText(text) {
    let hash = 2166136261;
    const input = String(text || '');
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
      hash ^= input.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }
    return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);
  }

  function stripJsonFence(text) {
    const raw = String(text || '').trim();
    const fenced = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (fenced) return fenced[1].trim();
    const start = raw.indexOf('{');
    const end = raw.lastIndexOf('}');
    if (start >= 0 && end > start) return raw.slice(start, end + 1);
    return raw;
  }

  function normalizeGender(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text === 'male' || text.includes('男')) return 'male';
    if (text === 'female' || text.includes('女')) return 'female';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function normalizeAge(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text === 'child' || /儿童|幼儿|小孩|童/.test(text)) return 'child';
    if (text === 'teen' || /少年|少女|青少年/.test(text)) return 'teen';
    if (text === 'young' || /青年|年轻/.test(text)) return 'young';
    if (text === 'middle' || /中年|成熟/.test(text)) return 'middle';
    if (text === 'senior' || /老年|老人|年长/.test(text)) return 'senior';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function localClassify(text) {
    const value = String(text || '');
    const hasDialogue = /[“”「」『』]|(?:^|[，。！？]\s*)[^，。！？]{1,12}[：:]/.test(value);
    let gender = 'unknown';
    let age = 'unknown';

    if (/她|姑娘|小姐|女士|母亲|妈妈|姐姐|妹妹|妻子|奶奶|婆婆/.test(value)) gender = 'female';
    if (/他|男人|先生|父亲|爸爸|哥哥|弟弟|丈夫|爷爷|老头/.test(value)) gender = 'male';
    if (/婴儿|幼儿|小朋友|小孩|孩子|童声/.test(value)) age = 'child';
    else if (/少年|少女|中学生|十[三四五六七八九]岁/.test(value)) age = 'teen';
    else if (/老人|老者|爷爷|奶奶|老头|老太/.test(value)) age = 'senior';
    else if (/中年|大叔|阿姨|父亲|母亲/.test(value)) age = 'middle';
    else if (hasDialogue) age = 'young';

    return {
      type: hasDialogue ? 'dialogue' : 'narrator',
      speaker: hasDialogue ? '未命名角色' : '旁白',
      gender: gender,
      age: age,
      confidence: 0.35
    };
  }

  function normalizeClassification(result, fallback) {
    const typeText = String(result.type || result.kind || '').toLowerCase();
    const speaker = String(result.speaker || result.role || '').trim();
    return {
      type: typeText === 'dialogue' || typeText.includes('对话') ? 'dialogue' : fallback.type,
      speaker: speaker || fallback.speaker,
      gender: normalizeGender(result.gender || fallback.gender),
      age: normalizeAge(result.age || result.age_group || fallback.age),
      confidence: Number(result.confidence || fallback.confidence || 0)
    };
  }

  async function classifyWithAI(text, settings) {
    const fallback = localClassify(text);
    if (!settings.aiEnabled || !settings.aiKey) return fallback;

    const cacheKey = 'ai_role_' + hashText(text);
    const cached = parseObject(await cache.get(cacheKey), null);
    if (cached) return normalizeClassification(cached, fallback);

    const recent = String((await cache.get('ai_recent_context')) || '').slice(-800);
    const prompt = [
      '你是中文小说朗读的角色分类器。',
      '判断“当前朗读片段”主要是旁白还是某个角色的对白；若是对白，推断说话人的称呼、性别和年龄层。',
      '只返回一个 JSON 对象，不要解释，也不要改写原文。',
      '固定字段：',
      '{"type":"narrator或dialogue","speaker":"角色称呼；不确定写未命名角色","gender":"male或female或unknown","age":"child或teen或young或middle或senior或unknown","confidence":0到1}',
      '判断规则：以当前片段为主，前文只用于消歧；无法确认时必须填 unknown，不要编造姓名。',
      '',
      '最近前文：',
      recent || '无',
      '',
      '当前朗读片段：',
      String(text || '').slice(0, 1800)
    ].join('\n');

    const body = {
      model: settings.aiModel,
      temperature: 0,
      response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
      messages: [
        {role: 'system', content: '你只输出严格 JSON。'},
        {role: 'user', content: prompt}
      ]
    };

    try {
      const response = await http.Post(
        normalizeEndpoint(settings.aiEndpoint),
        {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + settings.aiKey
        },
        JSON.stringify(body),
        'application/json',
        true
      );

      if (!response || Number(response.statusCode || 200) >= 400) {
        throw new Error('AI HTTP ' + (response ? response.statusCode : '无响应'));
      }

      const payload = parseObject(response.data || response.body || response, {});
      const content = payload.choices && payload.choices[0] && payload.choices[0].message
        ? payload.choices[0].message.content
        : payload.output_text;
      const parsed = parseObject(stripJsonFence(content), null);
      if (!parsed) throw new Error('AI 返回内容不是 JSON');

      const result = normalizeClassification(parsed, fallback);
      await cache.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(result));
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      await flutterBridge.log('AI角色识别失败，改用本地判断：' + error.message);
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  function pickFromPool(profile) {
    const gender = VOICE_POOLS[profile.gender] ? profile.gender : 'unknown';
    const age = VOICE_POOLS[gender][profile.age] ? profile.age : 'unknown';
    const pool = VOICE_POOLS[gender][age];
    return pool[parseInt(hashText(profile.speaker || '角色'), 36) % pool.length];
  }

  async function resolveVoice(profile, settings) {
    if (profile.type !== 'dialogue') return settings.narratorVoice;

    const voiceMap = parseObject(await cache.get('ai_speaker_voice_map'), {});
    const identity = [profile.speaker, profile.gender, profile.age].join('|');
    if (voiceMap[identity]) return voiceMap[identity];

    const voice = pickFromPool(profile);
    voiceMap[identity] = voice;
    await cache.set('ai_speaker_voice_map', JSON.stringify(voiceMap));
    return voice;
  }

  function speedPercent(speechRate) {
    const number = Number(speechRate);
    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return 0;
    return Math.max(-50, Math.min(100, Math.round((number - 10) * 10)));
  }

  function pitchFor(profile) {
    if (profile.age === 'child') return 18;
    if (profile.age === 'teen') return 8;
    if (profile.age === 'senior') return -12;
    return 0;
  }

  function buildProxyRequest(text, speechRate, voice, profile, settings) {
    const endpoint = settings.proxyEndpoint || DEFAULTS.proxyEndpoint;
    const separator = endpoint.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
    const url = endpoint + separator + [
      't=' + encodeURIComponent(text),
      'v=' + encodeURIComponent(voice),
      'r=' + speedPercent(speechRate),
      'p=' + pitchFor(profile)
    ].join('&');

    return {method: 'get', url: url, headers: {}};
  }

  // 阅读 App 调用的核心入口，不可删除或改名。
  async function getttsurl(speakText, speechRate) {
    const text = String(speakText || '').trim();
    const settings = await readSettings();
    const profile = await classifyWithAI(text, settings);
    const voice = await resolveVoice(profile, settings);

    const recent = String((await cache.get('ai_recent_context')) || '');
    await cache.set('ai_recent_context', (recent + '\n' + text).slice(-800));

    const request = buildProxyRequest(text, speechRate, voice, profile, settings);

    await flutterBridge.log(
      'AI配音：' + profile.speaker + ' / ' + profile.gender + ' / ' + profile.age + ' / ' + voice
    );
    return JSON.stringify(request);
  }

  async function setAiEnabled(enabled) {
    await cache.set('ai_role_enabled', enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
    await flutterBridge.showToast(enabled ? '已启用 AI 角色识别' : '已停用 AI，改用本地判断');
  }

  async function clearRoleCache() {
    await cache.remove('ai_speaker_voice_map');
    await cache.remove('ai_recent_context');
    await flutterBridge.showToast('角色和上下文缓存已清空');
  }

  // 返回非 http 内容时，阅读 App 会把下面的 JSON 显示成设置弹窗。
  async function getloginurl() {
    const ui = [
      {name: 'AI接口', type: 'text'},
      {name: 'AI密钥', type: 'password'},
      {name: 'AI模型', type: 'text'},
      {name: '启用AI', type: 'button', action: 'setAiEnabled(true)', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.33}},
      {name: '停用AI', type: 'button', action: 'setAiEnabled(false)', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.33}},
      {name: '清空角色', type: 'button', action: 'clearRoleCache()', style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.33}}
    ];
    return JSON.stringify(ui);
  }

  async function login() {}

  // 显式挂到 window，兼容使用反射查找入口函数的阅读 App WebView。
  window.getttsurl = getttsurl;
  window.getloginurl = getloginurl;
  window.login = login;
  window.setAiEnabled = setAiEnabled;
  window.clearRoleCache = clearRoleCache;
</script>
</html>
